 College Basketball Preview, Picks, and Best Bets for November 16 
 by Matthew Dewoskin  November 16, 2026 
 The Monday slate for college hoops isn’t the strongest we’ve seen this year. We have a few mid-major matchups, but the schedule has a lot of buy games and a lot of teams playing DII or NAIA schools. This is the kind of night that separates true degens from your random public bettor. We’ve found three numbers that look a little crooked for November 16th. Let’s dig into tonight’s college basketball picks.
 Looking for a sportsbook for our college basketball picks? Check out MyBookie.ag !
 College Basketball Preview, Picks, and Best Bets for November 16
 Matt Dewoskin ATS College Basketball Picks Record (Est.November 2, 2026) 
 All Selections: 19-23
Perfect 3-0 Cards: 2-12
 Western Kentucky at Tulsa
 Start Time: 7:00 PM EST 
 Western Kentucky enters this game with a 3-1 overall record and a 1-1 mark against the spread. The only game that the Hilltoppers failed to cover so far was a road loss to Tennessee Tech.
 Tulsa comes into this matchup with a 3-0 overall record and a 1-1 mark ATS. The Golden Hurricane failed to cover at home as a heavy favorite against Oral Roberts.
 These two teams played last year in the non-conference slate. Tulsa clipped Western Kentucky in Bowling Green, KY. The Hilltoppers were short favorites at home last year. This game comes with a revenge angle for Western Kentucky.
 The Hilltoppers don’t turn the ball over much and are good at limiting the number of fouls they allow on the defensive end. Western Kentucky is also known as a second-half team. The Hilltoppers average 49.0 points per game in the second half. If they can limit turnovers, keep Tulsa off the free-throw line, and have their second-half surge, the Hilltoppers can stay in this. Let’s ride with the Hilltoppers to keep this one close.
 Best Bet: Western Kentucky +7.5 
 Tarleton State at Drake
 Start Time 
 Tarleton State enters this matchup with a 3-1 overall record and a 1-1 mark ATS. They lost, but covered, in their only road game. The Texans lost by six to San Diego as a 7.5-point underdog.
 Drake comes into this game with a 3-0 overall record and a 0-2 mark ATS. The Bulldogs have failed to cover in each of their last two home games.
 Drake has looked rough defensively this year. This is a concern for the Bulldogs because Tarleton State can shoot, especially inside the arc. The Texans can also defend the rim. They average 10.0 blocks per game as a team.
 This game is also a step up in competition for Drake. They’ve only played teams ranked outside the top-250 in the country.
 Tarleton State needs to play this game at their pace. They need to speed up Drake, beat the Bulldogs in the paint, look to defend the perimeter, and stay out of transition.
 Drake has struggled to cover at home this year. We’ll keep riding with that trend until it breaks.
 Best Bet: Tarleton State +9.5 
 Abilene Christian at Missouri State
 Start Time: 8:00 PM EST 
 Missouri State comes into this game 3-0 overall, but they haven’t played a game that has had a point spread. The Bears have started the year with three straight home games against teams outside D1.
 Abilene Christian enters this matchup with a 1-2 overall record and a 2-1 mark ATS. The Wildcats covered and won as a short underdog at home against Lamar. They also lost at home to Stephen F. Austin, but covered as a 6.5-point underdog.
 The handicap here is simple. Missouri State hasn’t played anyone so far this year, and now they’re heading out against an Abilene Christian team that isn’t that different in talent level. Abilene Christian has tested themselves this year, while Missouri State has played it too safe. Lock up the Wildcats to get the cover against a Missouri State team that is the exact opposite of ‘battle-tested’.
 Best Bet: Abilene-Christian +7.5
